aboutGame.title: What is Build and Kill Zombies?
paragraphs: Build and Kill Zombies is a vehicle-building survival game on Roblox by Zombie Car Crusher. Construct a car, equip it for combat, and drive into waves of zombies.
Your runs revolve around earning cash and improving your vehicle. Weapons, fuel capacity, and added weight all affect the choices you make as you prepare to travel farther.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common Build and Kill Zombies questions.

items.question: What is Build and Kill Zombies?
items.answer: Build and Kill Zombies is a vehicle-building survival game on Roblox by Zombie Car Crusher. You build a car, equip it with weapons and defensive parts, drive into waves of zombies, and spend the Cash you earn on upgrades.

items.question: How do I redeem Build and Kill Zombies codes?
items.answer: Finish the Build and Kill Zombies tutorial, open SHOP on the left side of the screen, go to EXCLUSIVE SHOP, scroll down to the code box, enter a code such as COMMUNITY or CashDrop, and press REDEEM.

items.question: Why does my Build and Kill Zombies run end?
items.answer: A Build and Kill Zombies run ends when your vehicle runs out of fuel or is destroyed. Weapons and extra fuel tanks add weight, so balance firepower, fuel capacity, and upgrades to travel farther.

items.question: How many players can join a Build and Kill Zombies server?
items.answer: Each Build and Kill Zombies server holds up to 5 players. That is the server limit, not the number of seats on a single vehicle.

items.question: Is this Build and Kill Zombies Wiki official?
items.answer: No. Build and Kill Zombies Wiki is an independent fan-made guide site and is not affiliated with Zombie Car Crusher or Roblox. Play Build and Kill Zombies through its official Roblox page.
